facts.big: How do you like your eggs?
facts.label: Pedir e preparar o café
facts.sub: Pergunte How do you like your eggs? e responda Scrambled, please. Ofereça escolhas com Toast or pancakes? e diga o tempo com It is ready in five minutes.

facts.label: Ovos do seu jeito
facts.sub: Ao pedir ovos nos EUA, as pessoas dizem scrambled (mexidos), fried (fritos) ou boiled (cozidos). Em casa, quem cozinha pergunta “How do you like your eggs?”

facts.label: Panquecas
facts.sub: Panquecas com xarope são muito comuns nos fins de semana. Muitas famílias fazem uma pilha grande e cada um coloca manteiga, frutas ou xarope por cima.

pages.title: Eggs and toast · 1/3
paragraphs: It is seven o’clock on a sunny Sunday in Tampa. The kitchen smells like coffee and bread. Sam stands next to the stove with a pan. Dina walks in with sleepy eyes. They live together and cook on weekends. The table is empty, and the morning is quiet.
“Good morning! Do you want breakfast?” says Sam. “Yes, please. I am hungry.” says Dina. “How do you like your eggs?” says Sam.
